correctness.rationale: Direct substitution gives the exact scalar equation, the explicit second-order Fourier correction, and two third-order resonance identities checked by an independently executable symbolic script. The branch coefficients are kappa=(A²+2)/4>0 and nu=-(4A⁴-7A²+4)/(24A); transverse eigenvalue crossing and the nonzero cubic Hopf coefficient yield a locally unique supercritical orbitally stable cycle. Analytic Hopf reduction supports the O_A(mu²) remainder. The rational period derivative has strictly positive numerator 4(A²-7/8)²+15/16.

value.rationale: At the Hopf threshold the equilibrium determinant A² is exactly independent of B, so a linear-frequency prediction gives no B sensitivity. The explicit nonlinear derivative is nonzero and positive for every A>0, a mathematically motivated global-in-parameter sign rigidity for the local chemical oscillator frequency. Numerical canard period changes at finite amplitude do not replace this near-onset universal analytic information. No global or higher-order period behavior is claimed.
